title: DSWD aid for RSSI-hit farmers, laborers to hit P2B by December

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) will release about P500 million more by mid-December for sugarcane farmers and laborers affected by the red-stripe soft scale insect (RSSI) infestation on Negros Island, Regional Director Arwin Razo said. With the upcoming tranche, the total aid distributed this year is expected to reach about P2 billion, Razo said. READ: DSWD releases P410.3M to RSSI-hit sugarcane farmers in Negros As of Nov. 14, the DSWD has already distributed P1,439,654,725 to 139,833 beneficiaries across Negros Island. Most of the recipients for the incoming P500 million will be farm laborers, he added. […]... Keep on reading: DSWD aid for RSSI-hit farmers, laborers to hit P2B by December
